args.root_cause: In `paginate()`, the slice end index is computed as `end = start + page_size - 1` and then used as an exclusive bound in `items[start:end]`. This drops the last item of every page. With page_size=5 over 11 items, page 1 returns [1,2,3,4] (item 5 is lost), page 2 returns [6,7,8,9] (item 10 lost), and page 3 returns [11]... actually page 3 yields items[10:14] minus one -> items[10:9] = [] , so item 11 is also lost. The loss repeats every page_size items, matching the report's "regular interval" symptom. The correct exclusive end is `start + page_size`.
